notes.title: QoL patch
notes.notes: [p]In light of recent changes, we have reviewed your requests and made adjustments to improve your gaming experience:[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]- Added notification about the end of doctrine transition;[/p][p align="start"]- When choosing to change the main doctrine, the maximum possible transition effects and effects in the first month are indicated;[/p][p align="start"]- Rebalanced the Tax Doctrine in a Planned Economy;[/p][p align="start"]- OS now become cheaper after the Americans develop them, rather than more expensive, as was previously the case;[/p][p align="start"]- Adopting doctrines through a vote by a collective body (parliament) has become cheaper;[/p][p align="start"]- Soviet democracy now requires low privileges;[/p][p align="start"]- Bug fixes;[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]However, we are still working on a major update. Thank you for being with us! And don't forget to spread the word about our games among your friends, acquaintances, and various social groups. We love you![/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.7.01
notes.notes: [p]Update 1.0.7.01 includes:[/p][p align="start"]- The effects of doctrine transitions are now different and have a parabolic shape. Initially, they will be weak and will gradually increase towards the middle of the term, and then begin to fall again to zero.[/p][p align="start"]- Doctrine changes triggered by events that have a transitional type will now use a long transition instead of a quick one.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We always listen to you. In return, we ask you to recommend our games to your friends.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for being with us![/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.7.0
notes.notes:
[p]The update includes:
[/p][p align="start"]1. Brand new mechanics for changing core doctrines: Transition Period[/p][p align="start"]2. Rebalancing the Workweek Doctrine[/p][p align="start"]3. New event for Trump[/p][p align="start"]4. New achievement[/p][p align="start"]5. Taking into account the Partocrat trait for new politicians: the fewer privileges officials have, the less often new politicians with the Partocrat trait appear.[/p][p align="start"]6. Maximum contributions to military spending are limited by contributions to infrastructure[/p][p align="start"]7. Bug fixes[/p][p align="start"]8. Rebalancing of crisis events
[/p][p align="start"]And the next update will be a big one ;)[/p][p align="start"]Enjoy the game![/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.6.1999
notes.notes:
[p]Update 1.0.6.1999 includes:[/p][p align="start"]1. Display of authoritarianism and leftism indicators for doctrines and for the player on the political coordinates (when hovering over)[/p][p align="start"]2. Cooldown when changing doctrines now depends on difficulty[/p][p align="start"]3. NATO can now invade the USSR without the US in it[/p][p align="start"]4. Added a buff to Focus on Quality[/p][p align="start"]5. Two new achievements[/p][p align="start"]6. Bug fixes[/p][p align="start"]
[/p][p align="start"]Enjoy the game! Thank you for being with us![/p]

notes.title: Important news for modders
notes.notes: [p]The behavior of the “version” field in “info.json” has been changed. The “minVersion” and “maxVersion” fields have been added. Now you can specify the range of versions on which your mod will work so that it does not disappear with minor game updates. [/p][p]Detailed information is available in the guide:[/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1wx7_-HlL8xuPqtkEl89RhNqg5gvJyfTcA2CWuVnNQic/edit?usp=sharing"]https://docs.google.com/document/d/1wx7_-HlL8xuPqtkEl89RhNqg5gvJyfTcA2CWuVnNQic/edit?usp=sharing[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update x.6.924
notes.notes:
[p]Patch x.6.924 includes:
[/p][p align="start"]- The ability to “persuade” politicians to join conspiracies[/p][p align="start"]- Special interaction with Zanzibarland in special situations[/p][p align="start"]- New options for Poland's fate in the event[/p][p align="start"]- Reworked doctrines: Semi-public planned economy, Planned economy with elements of self-government, Planned economy with elements of the market, International treaties, Trade policy, Anonymization of the ruler, Private prisons, Union of trade unions and corporations, Ban on trade unions, and Nuclear deterrence.[/p][p align="start"]- Change in influence from contributions: Ecology, Special services, Cultural education, Civil servant salaries, Economic contributions[/p][p align="start"]- Increased effect of training politicians[/p][p align="start"]- Revision of the “Anti-alcohol campaign” modifier[/p][p align="start"]- Reworked minister attribute growth (linear replaced with curve)[/p][p align="start"]- Reworked algorithms for calculating elections in foreign countries[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Thank you for being with us![/p][p align="start"]Enjoy the game!
[/p][p align="start"]We have a small request: please share our game with your friends, YouTubers, and groups. We would be very grateful.[/p]

New variant of army doctrine - "PMC"[/p][p]2. 2 new events (on Trump's wall and on PMCs at low loyalty of generals and free market)[/p][p]3. Opportunity to support Greek neutrality[/p][p]4. notes.title: Update 1.0.6.5
notes.notes: [p]Update includes:[/p][p][/p][p]- Rebalancing (rebalancing some of the doctrines and their costs, some of the special modifiers, emergency, invasions, party displacement, and the effect of republics on political capital)[/p][p]- New events (4 on Trump and 1 on Canada)[/p][p]- Added drag and drop science queue[/p][p]- New statistics interface in events[/p][p]- Notification of the change of the leader of the Republic[/p][p]- Added diplomatic actions: impose ideology and force to abandon neutrality[/p][p]- Event on Lenin's Mausoleum now has a decision[/p][p]- Food program can be changed during the game[/p][p]- Cosmetic changes in map modes[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the game! We will be grateful if you recommend our game to your friends, bloggers, journalists and youtubers ;)[/p]

notes.title: The game is released
notes.notes: [p]Dear Friends.[/p][p]The day has come. The game is finally out. We express our great gratitude to you for waiting. It's been a difficult years of development, but we made it through. And you did too![/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the game![/p]

notes.title: THE GAME IS APPROVED FOR RELEASE ON JULY 11, 2025.
notes.notes: [p]Dear friends, as you all know this was a tough week for us. [/p][p]Due to our misscomunication with Steam we had to postpone the release date of Crisis in the Kremlin: The Cold War. We are deeply sorry for that and we will take measures to prevent this from happening in future. However, we are happy to announce that after our consultations with Steam representatives we decided on a new release date. Crisis in the Kremlin: The Cold War will be released on the 11th of July. [/p][p]We will delight you with a 10% discount, which will be active for a limited time after the release.[/p]

notes.title: Game sent for re-moderation
notes.notes: [p]Dear Friends.[/p][p]There's been a response from Steam. The game has been declined in verification for now. We have already urgently made all the necessary changes for re-moderation. And we have already sent the game for re-moderation. We apologise for upsetting you.[/p][p]We are waiting with you![/p]

notes.title: The game is ready and undergoing moderation.
notes.notes: [p]Dear friends![/p][p]The game is ready to play and is just going through moderation on Steam. The game will be released as soon as it gets approval from Valve. We hope it won't be long now. We apologise for any inconvenience.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience![/p][p]Love you![/p]

notes.title: The last release date: the 20th of June, 2025
notes.notes:
Dear Friends.

Due to the fact that May was a very busy month and thanks to your support and willingness to wait, we have decided to set the last and final release date for the 20th of June. In honour of this, we will also be adding more content and achievements to reward you for waiting.

We apologise. Please wait a little longer.

notes.title: Demo 7
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the release of Demo 7.0 with many significant changes:

1. New features in the politicians window
2. New features in the diplomacy window
3. New decisions and modifiers 
4. Improved Quality of Life (QoL) for players 
5. Total rebalance 
6. Bug fixes 
7. And, the demo has been extended by 2.5 months. The game will now end in mid-March 1986.

Also, unfortunately, we want to inform you that due to the voluminous amount of changes we have to postpone the game's release to 26 May 2025. But don't worry, the game is almost ready and is now in the stage of thorough testing and polishing! 

Thank you for being with us!
